tbesh_html:
1) to mourn, be dark
1a) (Qal) to be dark
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to darken
1b2) to cause to mourn
1c) (Hithpael) to grow dark

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be ashy, i.e. darkcolored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be black(-ish), be (make) dark(-en), [idiom] heavily, (cause to) mourn.
